prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
ai_overview_text:
To check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business, the best service depends on your budget and whether you want a dedicated AI tracker or an all-in-one SEO suite. Saffron Edge
Price: Starts around $29/month.
What it does: Tracks brand mentions, average position, share of voice, and website citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, and Gemini. OtterlyAI +4
Price: Around $95/month.
What it does: Simulates real browser prompts to analyze multi-engine share of voice, sentiment, and query fanouts without relying strictly on raw APIs. Zapier +3
Price: Built into or added onto standard SEO platform pricing.
What it does: Combines classic Google rank tracking with AI visibility monitoring for ChatGPT and other engines, letting you see traditional and AI-generated mentions side-by-side. Reddit·r/SEO_tools_reviews +4
Price: Enterprise tier.
What it does: Offers deep prompt tracking, source-level reporting, competitor benchmarking, and AI visibility gap analysis. Dageno AI +1
Tools like Ahrefs AI Visibility Checker, Siftly.ai, or free trials from platforms like Rankscale let you test a handful of buyer-intent prompts across ChatGPT and other LLMs without committing to a monthly subscription. Rankscale +3
Mention Rate / Share of Voice: How often ChatGPT names your business versus local competitors when users ask category-related questions (e.g., "What is the best small plumbing company in [City]?"). YouTube·Ryan Doser +2
Source Citations: Which specific web pages, local directories (like Yelp), or review sites the AI models look at and cite when recommending businesses. YouTube·JakeOnGrowth +1
Sentiment Tracking: Whether the AI describes your business favorably, neutrally, or flags outdated/negative details. YouTube·Vasco's SEO Tips +1
What is your industry or type of small business?
Are you looking for a free/low-cost quick check or an ongoing tracking dashboard?
